scope: The actual admit_scene_update function classifies ownership, closed state, empty frame, capacity, stale version and invalid successor. SourceRejected/NativeRejected are assigned by the candidate construction transaction after admission and are covered by the public integration test, not this pure admission kernel.

public_contract.compatibility: The existing bool apply/apply_update methods remain as is_ok projections.

ordered_stages.domain: all u64 owner/caller/current/expected/next values, all usize counts and bool open state

ordered_stages.reason: The classifier is a synchronous pure function over scalar inputs with no threads, locks, atomics, queues, allocation or shared mutation.

checks: stale version with exact expected/current payload
invalid successor with exact expected/next payload
every rejection left version and node count unchanged

limits: This does not prove Scene::apply_batch_at, Blitz candidate construction, full-frame rollback of third-party panic, or the whole apply_update transaction.
Host authentication remains separate; owner equality is an adapter guard, not a credential.
Checklist item 1 remains incomplete because the real Map obligation, whole-frame proof and float specification gaps remain.
